## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Roblox-inspired social game with chat in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Build now without clarification; make reasonable assumptions.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG (viewport at most 1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a standalone browser game, “Blocktown — Social Plaza,” with a canvas-rendered plaza and social-game UI.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added initial game UI, responsive styles, and plaza/gameplay implementation.

### Active
- Fix JavaScript syntax errors in `game.js` and validate the game in-browser.

### Blocked
- `node --check game.js` fails with `SyntaxError: Unexpected token '}'` at line 11 (`})();`), indicating an unmatched closing brace in the current file.

## Next Move
1. Inspect and fix the unmatched brace in `game.js`; run `node --check game.js`.
2. Open `http://localhost:3002` with Playwright, test UI/gameplay/chat, and save/read the latest small JPEG screenshot.
3. Check `git status` and report implementation and validation results.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI and DOM structure.
- `style.css`: Responsive game styling.
- `game.js`: Canvas rendering, controls, coins, emotes, and chat; currently has a syntax error.

## Important Context
- A Python HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Changes are uncommitted; no screenshots or browser tests have been completed.

- `index.html`: Game UI and DOM structure.
